current.text: Smart joined Houston this offseason. The Rockets guard rotation is crowded with Fred VanVleet back, Amen Thompson, Reed Sheppard and Bogdan Bogdanovic.
He is not in the projected starting five of VanVleet, Thompson, Durant, Smith and Sengun. He comes off the bench.
He may lead the Rockets bench in minutes. Coach Ime Udoka coached him in Boston and values defense.
Smart and Amen Thompson could take most of the point guard minutes over Reed Sheppard under Udoka.
He could become a streamer or stash when VanVleet sits.
With our March 28 end date, the Rockets play a weak 3-3-4 schedule in the fantasy playoffs, 10 games over three weeks.
The Rockets have only 14 back-to-backs this season.
He is not a draft target in a 144-player auction. Both sites rank him outside the top 200 with a value of 0 USD.

durable.text: He is not a traditional point guard, but he can bring the ball up and run the offense.
He takes good care of the ball and is still a really good defender.
The expert calls him an assists and steals player who will not score much.
His shooting is questionable. He is willing to shoot, but his FG% sits around 39 to 40 percent.
He gets hurt often and has missed many games in recent seasons.
